Terraviva An Phú - when kindness get taken advantage of
Oct 2025 • Friends
We have always been fond of the food and atmosphere at this pizza restaurant. However, recently, the restaurant manager contacted the rescue station, bringing in three kittens born from a stray cat in the restaurant. He asked a lot of questions about their living conditions and the potential for disease transmission. When the rescue station requested 250k per kitten for vaccinations, the restaurant manager refused to help, stating that the kittens weren't his responsibility and that he had no money to assist.

While it's true these aren't our cats either, we can't afford to care for all the stray animals in the world. If everyone starts bringing stray cats and expects us to take care of them, where will the rescue station find the funds to cover these expenses? As locals, our salaries are much lower than foreigners', and we too have jobs, families to care for. It doesn't mean our time, effort, and money should be expected to serve the irresponsible actions of others for free.

A true Italian restaurant that deserves 5stars!
Mar 2025 • Couples
Finally an excellent Italian restaurant abroad, where you really eat Italian! Run by an Italian! Carmine, very kind, welcoming and not intrusive! Nice and knowledgeable staff. All right, no criticism, but an applause to the place that has a beautiful open-air terrace over the city center. Lush and well-kept plants carefully frame the whole room, giving it a pleasant feeling of freedom and grace. Nice idea of baskets on the floor in which to put bags or backpacks. Good! The heart-shaped glasses also impressed us positively.
We ate a very very tasty and well made fresh pasta first course, and a plate of bresaola with parmesan and salad, really good and plentiful. Excellent raw materials. Nice display case of cold cuts and wood oven. A note for those who want to go there, the place is on the third floor of a building, on the street there is a round illuminated sign but do not look for a window, just the entrance of a small alley. It's worth it!
